# Pi extensions

> Extensions for the Pi coding agent: Slate (terminal UI), Ask (structured interviews), Automode (permission gate), Subagents (delegation), and Web Search (cited public retrieval).

Packages live at the repository root, not under `packages/`. Install each package separately. All five are published on npm.

## Documentation

- [Root README](README.md): package index, install, development
- [Slate README](pi-slate/README.md): TUI setup, commands, themes, composer keys
- [Ask README](pi-ask/README.md): `ask_user` contract, commands, TUI-only behavior
- [Automode README](pi-automode/README.md): permission gate, commands, rules, verified launcher, classifier review
- [Subagents README](pi-subagents/README.md): delegation contract and benchmarks
- [Web Search README](pi-web-search/README.md): tools, native Parallel MCP, optional Pi-hosted Jev classifier, config, credentials, limits
- [Web Search research](pi-web-search/docs/research.md): opt-in multi_search and Jev

## Packages

- [Root manifest](package.json): collection extensions, skills, and themes
- [Slate package](pi-slate/package.json): `npm:pi-slate`
- [Ask package](pi-ask/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-ask`
- [Automode package](pi-automode/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-automode`
- [Subagents package](pi-subagents/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-subagents`
- [Web Search package](pi-web-search/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-web-search`

## Agent indexes

- [Web Search llms.txt](pi-web-search/llms.txt): search navigation and source contracts
- [Slate llms.txt](pi-slate/llms.txt): TUI entry, themes, commands
- [Ask llms.txt](pi-ask/llms.txt): interview tool, skill, and schema

## Optional

- [Ask skill](pi-ask/skills/ask-user/SKILL.md): when the agent should call `ask_user`
- [Slate extension](pi-slate/extensions/pi-slate/index.ts): TUI replacement entry
- [Automode launcher](pi-automode/bin/pi-automode.js): verified startup and replacement
- [Web Search entry](pi-web-search/src/index.ts): tool registration and settings command
